$comment: The keys a spoke's terraform/secrets.enc may hold (LIB-0010 §4). `required` maps a condition to the keys it requires: `always`, `backend.<state_backend>`, or `provider.<name>` for each provider in spoke.hcl's providers map. Any key not listed under some condition must match one of `allowed_patterns`. Read by root.hcl at render time and by .github/scripts/check-secrets.sh in CI.
